mapper.insert: insert into document_chunk (paper_id, order_no, content, embedding_model, vector) values (#{paperId}, #{orderNo}, #{content}, #{embeddingModel}, #{vector,jdbcType=OTHER,typeHandler=com.wong.collector.infrastructure.persistence.typehandler.PgVectorTypeHandler}) on conflict (paper_id, order_no) do update set content = excluded.content, embedding_model = excluded.embedding_model, vector = excluded.vector
mapper.select: select p.paper_id, p.title, p.status as state, min(dc.embedding_model) as embedding_model, count(*) as chunk_count from paper p join document_chunk dc on dc.paper_id = p.paper_id where p.deleted = false and dc.vector is not null group by p.paper_id, p.title, p.status order by lower(p.title), p.paper_id

select id, paper_id, order_no, content, embedding_model from document_chunk where id in
CAST(#{id} AS bigint)
